description: Angular component for a date range navigator widget, including UI interactions, session storage handling, and overlay panel management.

classes.name: DateRangeNavigatorWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a date range navigator widget with overlay panel and session storage support.

classes.name: DateRangeNavigatorPanelComponent
classes.description: Overlay panel component for selecting date ranges within the widget.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, loads session storage, sets default date range, and subscribes to dashboard timewindow changes.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from dashboard timewindow change events.

methods.name: openNavigatorPanel
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for date range selection.

methods.name: widgetContextTimewindowSync
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with dashboard timewindow.

methods.name: updateAdvancedModel
methods.description: Updates model based on fixed dashboard timewindow.

methods.name: updateTimewindow
methods.description: Updates dashboard timewindow with specified start and end times.

methods.name: updateDateInterval
methods.description: Determines selected date interval based on current model.

methods.name: triggerChange
methods.description: Triggers timewindow update based on current model.

methods.name: changeInterval
methods.description: Adjusts timewindow based on selected interval.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Moves the date range backward by one step.

methods.name: goForth
methods.description: Moves the date range forward by one step.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Adjusts date range by a number of steps.

methods.name: readFromStorage
methods.description: Reads date range selection from session storage.

methods.name: updateStorageDate
methods.description: Saves current date range selection to session storage.

methods.name: saveIntoStorage
methods.description: Stores data in session storage under a specified key.

methods.name: choosedDate
methods.description: Handles date selection from overlay panel.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies selected date range and closes overlay.
